files.bin/audit.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
source config/audit.env
source lib/audit.sh
audit_nodes
files.lib/nodes.sh:
for_each_node() {
    local list="$1" callback="$2" host
    while IFS= read -r host; do
        [ -n "$host" ] || continue
        "$callback" "$host"
    done < "$list"
}
